item.title: Rabe‘s Feedback
item.content:encoded:
It's a refreshing new concept to use the BQ format for a story.

I think that the arc comes to the point a bit too fast, but that's okay for me.

While I definitely would have appreciated some paragraph breaks (you got some chunky walls of text), I found this to be very enjoyable. I think you really nailed the pacing, bringing together the pieces and the introduction of Nobody into the narrative pretty well. I think it works by itself also while setting up for the next piece.

Consider this an upvote.

item.title: Site Criticism Team - Junior Staff Review
item.content:encoded:
Alright, so I never really did get into the Black Queen stuff much myself, but this was pretty good. I pretty much upvoted at "It’s ya boi, Al.", and the rest of the piece chugged along at an enjoyable enough pace to maintain that upvote.

I enjoyed your characterizations, and the fact that you (mostly) made all of the black queens distinct from one another, with Al just basically taking the piss the whole time and Ariadne obviously being new to this whole Black Queen thing standing out in particular. I do think that Erasmus was easily the most boring of the four, almost serving as a Gnosis-lite, and was really just in there to be the one to give Al shit for goofing off.

+ Spoiler?
- Close

I also liked the white text and the fade out of the other black queens. Cool little easter eggs for a reader who was paying extra attention. Good stuff.

One major complaint that I have with this, however, is that the beginning of this article is super hectic. It would have been nice to see one of the more assertive Black Queens (Gnosis probably?) take the reigns for the beginning of the article, just to make the mental image of what we're dealing with here a bit more clear. I didn't really understand the anomalous properties of the island itself super well on first read, and so had a hard time figuring out what was actually going on.

Those issues ultimately didn't take much away from my enjoyment of the piece, but I definitely did notice them. I still upvoted, but there's room for improvement here.
